steps.title: Menu → System → Alert Rules
steps.details: What creates an alert and when: the event's table and date, days before or after, recurrence, priority and the email, WhatsApp or SMS templates that are sent.

steps.title: Category
steps.details: Required: which group of the Alerts Center its alerts show in.

steps.title: Source
steps.details: Required: where the cases come from (appointments, invoices, patients…).

steps.title: ID field
steps.details: Required: the column that identifies each case in the table (almost always «id»).

steps.title: Event date
steps.details: The date the days are counted from.

steps.title: Send email automatically
steps.details: If checked, the email goes out on its own when the alert is created.
